title: Dedalo ledger verification
description: Output of `dedalo verify --json`: whether the hash-chained ledger in .dedalo/ is internally consistent. Needs no network and no key — anyone with a clone can run it.

ok.description: Also reflected in the exit code, so a script can branch on either.

head.description: Id of the newest entry, or null for a ledger with no entries yet.

problems.description: Empty when `ok` is true. An entry edited after the fact breaks every id since, so one edit usually reports many problems.
